description: Needs a rent.dev account: sign in when your client offers it, or call rent_signup first. The public HTTPS URL of a port in the sandbox (`https://{port}-{sandbox}.{domain}`). It serves while the sandbox runs and something listens on the port.

sandbox_id.description: Sandbox id (`lse_…`) from rent_create_sandbox or rent_list_sandboxes. It names the sandbox for its whole life and keeps answering rent_get_sandbox, with the final state, after it ends.

name: rent_get_port_url
title: Get a port URL
